title: Repository agent steering
event: Agents change this sandbox without reading its bounded infrastructure rules.
pattern: Generic agent defaults drift into bootstrap or deploy actions the sandbox does not allow.
structure: Steering lived in README and runbooks, separate from the file agents read first.
archetype: Shifting the Burden: reviewers catch out-of-bounds changes after they are written.
intervention: Keep the shared governance section and add the sandbox steering rules beneath it.
leading_indicators: AGENTS.md contains the AI-GOVERNANCE marker and the sandbox steering section.
transfer: Repo-specific rules stay below the shared governance section and can only tighten it.
